commits.message: Visual rows are stated under the default end, and the padding claim is gone (rich-unfiled-791c.pe16)
Visual rows are stated as the render ends them: each followed by a break, one per logical row (rich-unfiled-791c.pe16)

Visual rows are taken off the render, and a test holds them to it (rich-unfiled-791c.pe16)

A visual row is ordered by levels resolved over its whole line, so wrap keeps
refusing it. Segment.splitLines of the render is each placed row; the test
pins that drawn one per line they equal the render in bytes, HTML and SVG,
including the RTL hanging-whitespace and neutral/number-at-a-break cases.

* The docs site serves its own xterm.js instead of loading it from jsDelivr (rich-unfiled-791c.abt1)

xterm.js is the @xterm/xterm devDependency bundled as its own chunk, so a
stalled CDN can no longer strand a live terminal at its Run button, and
package.json is the one version pin. The e2e CDN route (e2e/test.ts) and its
gate (test/seam/e2e-cdn.test.ts) go with docs/.vitepress/theme/xterm.ts.
